title: Is the Order a Rabbit?
native: ご注文はうさぎですか？
synopsis:
Coming to a new town to start high school can be intimidating, and that's especially true for Cocoa, who can't find the place she's supposed to be staying when she arrives. When she stops at a cafe to ask for directions, however, it turns out that she's already where she needs to be! You see, the Rabbit House is both a restaurant and a boarding house, and Cocoa will be working there along with the owner's granddaughter, Chino and the strangely military-obsessed Rize. It's a great place to work, business is hopping, and Cocoa's fits right in with her new coworkers, as well as the girls from two other rival cafes. Still, there is something just a little odd about the Rabbit House. Besides the fact that Rize usually carries a Glock and a knife hidden on her, there's also a mystery involving the shop's pet rabbit, Tippy. And then there are those girls who sometimes seem to be able to communicate without talking…

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

episodes.title: I Knew at First Glance That It Was No Ordinary Fluffball
episodes.synopsis: Cocoa's first day at the Rabbit House Cafe is lively as she meets and becomes friends with Chino and Lize in a heartbeat, while also learning about her new friends' amazing talents.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Loved Wheat and the Girl Loved by Azuki Beans.
episodes.synopsis: While getting ready for the first day of school, Cocoa runs into a new friend at the park. After introductions, Cocoa's new and old friends decide to bake bread and visit Chiya's coffee house.

episodes.title: Do You Remember the Day You First Got Drunk? You Tried to Light a Campfire in Your Own Home, Didn't You?
episodes.synopsis: While out shopping for new mugs, Cocoa and company run into a new friend, Sharo. Afterwards, they enjoy some tea at Sharo's teahouse and spend the night at Rabbit house telling scary stories.

episodes.title: Your Lucky Items Are Vegetables, Crime, and Punishment.
episodes.synopsis: Chino is worried about her height, and actively attempts to grow using less than verified methods. Cocoa practices her fortune telling technique using caffe-de-mancy, and the girls head to the library on a sunny afternoon.

episodes.title: Cocoa and Murderous Intent Without Malice
episodes.synopsis: The girls begin practicing for the ball sports tournament at school, with unsurprising results. Father's Day is coming up, and Rize takes up extra jobs to get something special for her father.

episodes.title: A Story About Telling a Story
episodes.synopsis: Cocoa and Chino go out for a walk around town on their day off. Later, Chino's friends help out at the Rabbit House and take a shining to Cocoa and Lize, leaving Chino the odd man out.

episodes.title: Call Me Sister
episodes.synopsis: Chino and Cocoa get into small, cute fights with each other over puzzles and pancakes. Later, the girls hand out flyers for their cafes.

episodes.title: Wet with Pool Water, Wet with Rain, Wet with Tears
episodes.synopsis: The girls head off to a hot spring for a relaxing break.

episodes.title: Aoyama Slump Mountain
episodes.synopsis: Chino's grandfather's backstory is revealed, and Rize is chosen as the lead in the school prouction of the Phantom of the Opera.

episodes.title: The Anti-Sister Battle Corps, Also Known As the Chimame Corps
episodes.synopsis: While Cocoa helps Chiya study for the upcoming exams, Megu and Maya help our at Rabbit House. Later, a trip to the pool is in order.

episodes.title: The Girl Dons a Red Coat and Drives a Team of Rabbits Across the Christmas Eve Night Sky
episodes.synopsis: To celebrate the Christmas season, the girls decide to throw a Christmas party. Let the planning commence!

episodes.title: For You, I Can Sleep Late
episodes.synopsis: Cocoa runs a fever and the girls head out to get her some feel better medicine.
